test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is/are a capital receipt for the government ?

(A) Loans taken by the government from the public

(B) Borrowings from foreign countries and Institutes

(C) Disinvestment of assets
solution:
The correct answer is __**All - A, B and C.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Capital receipts** refer to the **inflow of funds** that create liabilities or reduce assets for the government.
 
• Loans taken by the government from the public, borrowings from **foreign countries and institutes**, and disinvestment of assets are all examples of capital receipts.
 
• Loans taken by the government from the public are a form of** borrowing **and **create a liability** for the government.
 
• **Borrowings **from foreign countries and institutes also create a liability for the government and are usually accompanied by conditions and terms of repayment.
 
• **Disinvestment of assets **refers to the sale of government-owned assets like **shares, land, or buildings, and generates revenue** for the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Capital receipts** are earnings from **non-routine or infrequently** occurring activity.
 
• An organization's primary or consistent source of income is **not** capital receipts.
 
• Additionally, due to their capital nature, these receipts are displayed on a **company's balance sheet **rather than in the income statement or profit and loss account.
 
• The recording of these receipts follows the** accrual method.**
 
• Additionally, unlike revenue receipts, capital receipts cannot be used for the distribution of profit due to their **non-recurring nature**.
